id.instruksi: Dengarkan tebakan dan hasilnya. Apakah hasilnya mendukung tebakan? Sentuh jawabanmu.
id.t-es: Tebakan: es di bawah Matahari mencair lebih dulu. Hasil: es di bawah Matahari habis lebih dulu.
id.t-tanaman: Tebakan: tanaman di jendela tumbuh paling tinggi. Hasil: tanaman di lemari tumbuh paling tinggi.
id.t-mobil: Tebakan: mobil meluncur paling jauh di lantai licin. Hasil: mobil meluncur paling jauh di lantai keramik yang paling licin.
id.t-gula: Tebakan: semua gula di gelas air larut setelah diaduk. Hasil: masih ada butiran gula di dasar gelas.
id.t-bayangan: Tebakan: bayangan membesar saat boneka didekatkan ke senter. Hasil: saat boneka digeser mendekat, bayangannya di dinding membesar.
id.t-magnet: Tebakan: magnet menarik kaleng minuman. Hasil: kaleng minuman tidak bergerak.
id.t-jemuran: Tebakan: baju di bawah Matahari kering lebih dulu. Hasil: baju di dalam rumah kering lebih dulu.
id.t-bola: Tebakan: bola karet memantul lebih tinggi dari bola kain. Hasil: bola karet memantul lebih tinggi.
id.t-serap: Tebakan: spons menyerap air paling banyak. Hasil: kain menyerap paling banyak, spons kedua.
id.t-kecambah: Tebakan: dari dua biji sejenis, yang diberi air berkecambah lebih dulu. Hasil: biji yang diberi air memang berkecambah lebih dulu.

en.judul: Do the Results Support the Prediction?
en.instruksi: Listen to the prediction and the result. Does the result support the prediction? Touch your answer.
en.t-es: Prediction: the ice in the sun melts first. Result: the ice in the sun was gone first.
en.t-tanaman: Prediction: the plant by the window grows tallest. Result: the plant in the cupboard grew tallest.
en.t-mobil: Prediction: the car rolls furthest on the slippery floor. Result: the car rolls furthest on the tiled floor, the most slippery one.
en.t-gula: Prediction: all the sugar in the glass of water dissolves after stirring. Result: some grains of sugar remain on the bottom.
en.t-bayangan: Prediction: the shadow grows when the toy moves closer to the torch. Result: as the toy moved closer, its shadow on the wall grew.
en.t-magnet: Prediction: the magnet pulls the drink can. Result: the can didn't move.
en.t-jemuran: Prediction: the shirt in the sun dries first. Result: the shirt indoors dried first.
en.t-bola: Prediction: the rubber ball bounces higher than the cloth ball. Result: the rubber ball bounced higher.
en.t-serap: Prediction: the sponge soaks up the most water. Result: the cloth soaked up the most, the sponge came second.
en.t-kecambah: Prediction: of two seeds of the same kind, the watered one sprouts first. Result: the watered seed did sprout first.
